note: skills, memory, store knowledge and the chat loop, the first three with their routes

areas.name: skills
areas.doc: Skills: the merchant's own instructions and playbooks for the assistant. The store and its limits, frontmatter, names and sections, the index, the ranking for a question, the reading pass that writes when a skill applies, and what goes into the AI's instructions. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes are in gizmo/routes/skills.py. Read as `skillbook.NAME` (`skills` is a local name in several functions).

areas.name: memory
areas.doc: Memory: the facts, decisions and follow-ups the assistant keeps across sessions. The store, adding (checked against what was said), editing, follow-ups, a member's notes held for an admin, and what goes into the AI's instructions. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its route is in gizmo/routes/memory.py. Read as `memory.NAME`.

areas.name: knowledge
areas.doc: Store knowledge: what was learned once from the store's own site, kept until deleted. The store, the learn run that reads the site's pages, and what goes into the AI's instructions. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes are in gizmo/routes/knowledge.py. Read as `knowledge.NAME`.

areas.name: chat
areas.doc: The chat loop: one turn of the assistant with its tool rounds, the words shown for each step while it works, the previews of what a tool returned, and what happens after an answer (memories kept, follow-ups closed, skills noted). Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit). Its two routes stay in add_routes, which builds the tool list they use from the registry it is handed; the system prompt stays in copilot.py, built from the shared writing style as the app loads. Read as `assistant.NAME`.

routes.name: routes_skills
routes.doc: The skills' routes: the list and its edits, and reading one skill. Gathered from add_routes (stage 4 of the 14 October audit) where the first stood; their paths are literal, so no request changes hands.
routes.register_doc: Add the skills' routes to the app.
routes.comment: The skills' routes (gizmo/routes/skills.py), gathered where the first stood.
